subFields.name: Passenger Name
subFields.instruction: Extract name as printed on passport. Example: USHA M.

subFields.name: Passport Number
subFields.instruction: Extract passport number from MRZ line 1 — mandatory for SALE. Example: P1234567

subFields.name: Passport Issue From
subFields.instruction: Extract place of issue — mandatory if PASSPORTNO present. Example: MUM

subFields.name: Passport Issue Date
subFields.instruction: Extract passport issue date — mandatory if PASSPORTNO present; must be past or current date. Example: 01-APR-2020

subFields.name: Passport Expiry Date
subFields.instruction: Extract passport expiry date — mandatory if PASSPORTNO present; must be future date, flag if expired. Example: 31-MAR-2030

subFields.name: Date of Birth
subFields.instruction: Extract date of birth — must be past date, validate before submission. Example: 22-FEB-1972

subFields.name: Gender
subFields.instruction: Extract gender — passport shows M/F, map to Male/Female/Other. Example: FEMALE

subFields.name: Nationality
subFields.instruction: Extract nationality — must match Maraekat enum, use reference data API. Example: INDIAN

subFields.name: First Name
subFields.instruction: Extract first name split from PAXNAME — either PAXNAME or FIRSTNAME must be present.

subFields.name: Last Name
subFields.instruction: Extract last name split from PAXNAME — parse last word.

subFields.name: PAN Number
subFields.instruction: Extract PAN number — 10-char pattern: 5 alpha + 4 numeric + 1 alpha, validate regex; mandatory for SALE. Example: AUZPM2687E

subFields.name: PAN Card Holder Name
subFields.instruction: Extract full name on PAN — often differs from PAXNAME, extract separately; mandatory if PANNO present. Example: USHA SHAILESH MEISHERI

subFields.name: Father Name
subFields.instruction: Extract father name if printed on PAN card — not always present.

subFields.name: First Name
subFields.instruction: Extract first name split from PAXNAME — either PAXNAME or FIRSTNAME must be present.

subFields.name: Last Name
subFields.instruction: Extract last name split from PAXNAME — parse last word.

fields.name: Derived from PAN Number
fields.instruction: Derive fields from PAN number — no OCR needed

subFields.name: Type of Person
subFields.instruction: Derive from 4th character of PANNO — P = Person, C = Corporate. Example: P

subFields.name: Aadhaar Card Number
subFields.instruction: Extract Aadhaar card number — for PURCHASE, any one ID (Aadhaar / Voter / Driving Licence) is mandatory.

subFields.name: Passenger Address
subFields.instruction: Extract passenger address — either PAXADDRESS or BuildingFlatNO must be present.

subFields.name: Building / Flat Number
subFields.instruction: Extract building or flat number — either BuildingFlatNO or PAXADDRESS must be present.

subFields.name: Street Name
subFields.instruction: Extract street name — address line 2.

subFields.name: Location
subFields.instruction: Extract location — either LOCATION or CITY must be present. Example: MUMBAI

subFields.name: City
subFields.instruction: Extract city — either LOCATION or CITY must be present. Example: MUMBAI

subFields.name: Pin Code
subFields.instruction: Extract pin code — numeric only, 6 digits, no spaces. Example: 400080

subFields.name: State Name
subFields.instruction: Extract state name — must match Maraekat enum, use reference data API. Example: MAHARASHTRA

subFields.name: Passenger Address
subFields.instruction: Extract passenger address — either PAXADDRESS or BuildingFlatNO must be present.

subFields.name: Parent Name
subFields.instruction: Extract parent name — not on standard ID docs.

subFields.name: Building / Flat Number
subFields.instruction: Extract building or flat number — either BuildingFlatNO or PAXADDRESS must be present.

subFields.name: Street Name
subFields.instruction: Extract street name — address line 2.

subFields.name: Voter Card Number
subFields.instruction: Extract voter card number — for PURCHASE, any one ID mandatory.

subFields.name: Driving Licence Number
subFields.instruction: Extract driving licence number — for PURCHASE, any one ID mandatory.

subFields.name: Country
subFields.instruction: Extract country — must match Maraekat enum, use reference data API. Example: INDIA

subFields.name: PNR Number
subFields.instruction: Extract PNR number — for SALE, either PNRNO or TICKETNO is mandatory. Example: PNR123

subFields.name: Ticket Number
subFields.instruction: Extract ticket number — for SALE, either PNRNO or TICKETNO is mandatory.

subFields.name: Airline Name
subFields.instruction: Extract airline name — for SALE mandatory; must match Maraekat enum, use reference data API. Example: AIR CANADA

subFields.name: Departure From
subFields.instruction: Extract IATA airport code of departure — for SALE mandatory. Example: MUM

subFields.name: Departure Date
subFields.instruction: Extract departure date — for SALE mandatory; must be future or today, validate before submission. Example: 01-APR-2026

subFields.name: Traveling Country
subFields.instruction: Extract traveling country — for SALE mandatory; must match Maraekat enum, use reference data API. Example: UNITED KINGDOM

subFields.name: Arrival Date
subFields.instruction: Extract arrival date — for PURCHASE mandatory; must be past or current date.

subFields.name: Route
subFields.instruction: Extract route — free field, optional. Example: MUM-LHR
